what-a-finish-actually-is.title: Wood surface with finish film layers
what-a-finish-actually-is.alt: Cross-section schematic: wood fibers, penetrating oil, and surface film on furniture
what-a-finish-actually-is.caption: A finish can occupy pores and build a film on top; adhesion and thickness decide whether it survives use.

film-versus-penetrating.title: Penetrating finish versus film finish
film-versus-penetrating.alt: Shop diagram comparing in-the-wood oil versus built varnish film on furniture
film-versus-penetrating.caption: Penetrating systems wet fibers; film systems protect from above. Most cans blend both behaviors.

binder-solvent-additive.title: Finish can anatomy: binder carrier additives
binder-solvent-additive.alt: Schematic of furniture finish ingredients: binder solvent and shop additives
binder-solvent-additive.caption: The binder becomes the solid; the carrier leaves; additives change dry time sheen and flow.

why-some-woods-drink-and-some-spit.title: Open versus closed grain wood
why-some-woods-drink-and-some-spit.alt: End-grain schematic showing open ring-porous oak versus tight maple for finish absorption
why-some-woods-drink-and-some-spit.caption: Ring-porous woods drink finish into vessels; diffuse-porous woods often need fewer coats.

the-shop-safe-fence.title: Shop-safe finishing scope
the-shop-safe-fence.alt: Flowchart of allowed shop finishing topics versus formulation and hazmat outside scope
the-shop-safe-fence.caption: Commercial products and ventilation yes; distillation synthesis and waste dumping no.

linseed-oil-polymerizes.title: Linseed oil oxygen cure
linseed-oil-polymerizes.alt: Schematic linseed oil taking oxygen and crosslinking on wood surface
linseed-oil-polymerizes.caption: Raw linseed needs air and time; heat in a wadded rag is the same chemistry without escape.

tung-oil-and-the-can-that-lied.title: True tung oil versus wiping varnish label
tung-oil-and-the-can-that-lied.alt: Comparison of pure tung oil cure versus blended wiping varnish in a mislabeled can
tung-oil-and-the-can-that-lied.caption: Pure tung is slow and matte; many cans are varnish with a tung adjective.

danish-oil-is-a-wiping-varnish.title: Danish oil as oil plus varnish blend
danish-oil-is-a-wiping-varnish.alt: Diagram of Danish oil layers: linseed or tung fraction plus alkyd varnish in mineral spirits
danish-oil-is-a-wiping-varnish.caption: Danish oil is usually wiping varnish: oil for look varnish for build if you leave it on.

hardwax-oil-the-wax-is-the-last-coat.title: Hardwax oil film stack
hardwax-oil-the-wax-is-the-last-coat.alt: Cross-section of oil cure with wax buffed on furniture surface
hardwax-oil-the-wax-is-the-last-coat.caption: Oil polymerizes in the wood; wax sits last and governs feel and renewability.

a-curing-schedule-that-respects-oxygen.title: Oil cure schedule with oxygen
a-curing-schedule-that-respects-oxygen.alt: Timeline for wiping oil coats with dry between and full cure before topcoat
a-curing-schedule-that-respects-oxygen.caption: Recoat when tack-free; full hardness waits on oxygen not calendar optimism.

bloom-wrinkle-and-the-rag-that-never-dri.title: Oil bloom and wrinkle defects
bloom-wrinkle-and-the-rag-that-never-dri.alt: Schematic of wrinkled oil film from thick coat and bloom from trapped solvent
bloom-wrinkle-and-the-rag-that-never-dri.caption: Wrinkle is too much oil too little air; bloom is solvent trapped under skin.

oil-on-teak-rosewood-and-other-greasy-ci.title: Oily exotic wood prep
oil-on-teak-rosewood-and-other-greasy-ci.alt: Prep flow for teak rosewood: degrease shellac seal then finish
oil-on-teak-rosewood-and-other-greasy-ci.caption: Extractives fight adhesion; clean test coat on scrap before the show face.

alkyd-varnish-the-shop-standard.title: Alkyd varnish film on wood
alkyd-varnish-the-shop-standard.alt: Alkyd resin crosslinking as mineral spirits leave furniture surface
alkyd-varnish-the-shop-standard.caption: Alkyd is the shop workhorse: build coats amber slowly and sand between.

oil-modified-polyurethane-without-the-ma.title: Oil-modified polyurethane versus straight alkyd
oil-modified-polyurethane-without-the-ma.alt: Compare oil-modified PU flexibility and amber to straight alkyd varnish
oil-modified-polyurethane-without-the-ma.caption: Oil-mod PU trades a little yellow for flexibility; still a film finish.

spar-varnish-and-porch-chalk.title: Spar varnish UV flex additives
spar-varnish-and-porch-chalk.alt: Schematic spar varnish with UV absorbers and softer oil for exterior chalking
spar-varnish-and-porch-chalk.caption: Spar moves more and chalks outdoors; interior table tops want a harder film.

wipe-on-varnish-is-just-thin-varnish.title: Wipe-on versus brush varnish same resin
wipe-on-varnish-is-just-thin-varnish.alt: Same alkyd resin thinned for wipe-on versus full brush coat build rate
wipe-on-varnish-is-just-thin-varnish.caption: Wipe-on is thin varnish many passes; not a different chemistry.

recoat-windows-and-intercoat-adhesion.title: Recoat window for varnish
recoat-windows-and-intercoat-adhesion.alt: Timeline for sanding between varnish coats versus wet recoat window
recoat-windows-and-intercoat-adhesion.caption: Inside the window the next coat melts in; outside it needs scuff or strip.

amber-plastic-and-the-look-people-return.title: Amber alkyd versus waterborne clear
amber-plastic-and-the-look-people-return.alt: Color comparison amber oil varnish versus clear acrylic waterborne on maple
amber-plastic-and-the-look-people-return.caption: Amber warms oak; waterborne stays cooler; neither is cheating if disclosed.

shellac-is-a-bug-resin.title: Shellac flake to alcohol solution
shellac-is-a-bug-resin.alt: Shellac lac resin dissolved in denatured alcohol forming brushable film
shellac-is-a-bug-resin.caption: Flakes or buttons plus alcohol; alcohol leaves and resin reflows into a film.

cuts-flakes-and-why-dewaxed-exists.title: Shellac cut and dewaxed grades
cuts-flakes-and-why-dewaxed-exists.alt: Compare pound cut shellac dewaxed versus waxed for sealer under other finishes
cuts-flakes-and-why-dewaxed-exists.caption: Dewaxed sticks to the next coat; waxed resists waterborne and some varnishes.

french-polish-without-the-monastery.title: French polish pad path
french-polish-without-the-monastery.alt: French polishing with shellac pad oil lubricant and spiriting off
french-polish-without-the-monastery.caption: Pad deposits thin shellac; oil lubricates; spirit cleans the last pass.

shellac-as-the-diplomat.title: Shellac sealer between dissimilar coats
shellac-as-the-diplomat.alt: Shellac barrier coat between stain and varnish or waterborne stacks
shellac-as-the-diplomat.caption: Dewaxed shellac isolates incompatible layers when the label stack is honest.

blush-alcohol-and-a-humid-tuesday.title: Shellac blush in humidity
blush-alcohol-and-a-humid-tuesday.alt: Schematic white shellac blush when alcohol traps moisture on humid day
blush-alcohol-and-a-humid-tuesday.caption: Blush is moisture in the film; slow thinner or dehumidify before the next pass.

what-shellac-cannot-survive.title: Shellac limits heat water alcohol
what-shellac-cannot-survive.alt: Table of shellac weakness to heat water rings and alcohol spills
what-shellac-cannot-survive.caption: Shellac repairs fast and fails fast on bar tops and radiators.

waterborne-means-emulsion.title: Waterborne latex emulsion particles
waterborne-means-emulsion.alt: Schematic polymer particles in water coalescing into film as water leaves
waterborne-means-emulsion.caption: Waterborne is dispersed plastic in water; coalescence not simple drying.

grain-raise-is-swelling.title: Grain raise from waterborne
grain-raise-is-swelling.alt: Wood fibers swollen after waterborne first coat requiring knockback sand
grain-raise-is-swelling.caption: Water swells fibers; first coat raises grain; knock back before color or top.

acrylic-versus-waterborne-polyurethane.title: Acrylic latex versus waterborne polyurethane
acrylic-versus-waterborne-polyurethane.alt: Compare acrylic emulsion clarity versus PUD polyurethane toughness on furniture
acrylic-versus-waterborne-polyurethane.caption: Acrylic stays clear and softer; PUD reads tougher and can amber slightly.

coalescent-cold-shops-and-the-film-that-.title: MFFT and cold shop coalescence failure
coalescent-cold-shops-and-the-film-that-.alt: Waterborne film failing to knit below minimum film formation temperature
coalescent-cold-shops-and-the-film-that-.caption: Cold shop leaves tacky white particles; warm room or coalescent-rated product.

waterborne-over-oil-the-honest-sequence.title: Stacking waterborne over cured oil
waterborne-over-oil-the-honest-sequence.alt: Sequence: fully cured oil scuff shellac optional then waterborne topcoat
waterborne-over-oil-the-honest-sequence.caption: Oil must cure; scuff for bite; dewaxed shellac if the stack is picky.

foam-leveling-and-the-cheap-applicator.title: Foam applicator bubbles in waterborne
foam-leveling-and-the-cheap-applicator.alt: Foam brush trapping air bubbles in waterborne finish on table top
foam-leveling-and-the-cheap-applicator.caption: Foam injects air; quality synthetic brush or spray for level film.

milk-paint-is-casein-and-lime.title: Milk paint casein lime binder
milk-paint-is-casein-and-lime.alt: Casein protein and lime in milk paint forming matte chalky film
milk-paint-is-casein-and-lime.caption: Real milk paint sets by protein and lime; acrylic latex imitates the look.

bonding-coats-and-the-myth-of-universal-.title: Bonding coat for milk paint
bonding-coats-and-the-myth-of-universal-.alt: Bonding agent or scuff prep before milk paint on slick old finish
bonding-coats-and-the-myth-of-universal-.caption: Chalk needs tooth; bonding coat or mechanical scratch not magic stick.

milk-paint-over-an-old-film.title: Milk paint over existing finish
milk-paint-over-an-old-film.alt: Milk paint on scuffed varnish versus peeling on glossy old film
milk-paint-over-an-old-film.caption: Glossy urethane needs prep; bare wood or bonded surface holds chalk.

topcoating-milk-paint-without-killing-th.title: Topcoats over milk paint sheen
topcoating-milk-paint-without-killing-th.alt: Compare wax versus thin waterborne over milk paint keeping chalk look
topcoating-milk-paint-without-killing-th.caption: Wax keeps chalk; heavy poly fills pores and kills the point.

chip-and-crackle-defect-history-or-theat.title: Intentional crackle versus failure chip
chip-and-crackle-defect-history-or-theat.alt: Crackle glaze chemistry versus accidental chip on weak bond coat
chip-and-crackle-defect-history-or-theat.caption: Theater crackle is a product stack; accidental chip is adhesion or brittleness.

sanding-decides-the-film.title: Grit sequence before finish
sanding-decides-the-film.alt: Sanding progression 120 to 180 to 220 before first finish coat
sanding-decides-the-film.caption: Coarser scratch shows through thin films; last grit sets the sheen base.

dye-stain-and-the-finish-on-top.title: Dye stain under film finish
dye-stain-and-the-finish-on-top.alt: Dye in wood fibers with clear film on top versus pigment stain in surface
dye-stain-and-the-finish-on-top.caption: Dye moves in fiber; pigment sits in pores; topcoat choice follows.

compatibility-in-prose.title: Finish compatibility test path
compatibility-in-prose.alt: Scrap board test stack before committing finish on client piece
compatibility-in-prose.caption: Same species same prep; test the whole stack not the last can alone.

repair-without-stripping-the-whole-piece.title: Localized finish repair
repair-without-stripping-the-whole-piece.alt: Feather sand blend repair shellac pad on damaged finish spot
repair-without-stripping-the-whole-piece.caption: Identify binder; feather edge; patch in family; blend sheen last.

maintenance-years-later.title: Finish maintenance years after install
maintenance-years-later.alt: Timeline for wax refresh oil re-coat versus full scuff and recoat
maintenance-years-later.caption: Penetrating oils want periodic feed; films want abrasion repair or recoat.

rags-air-and-the-fire-you-do-not-see-com.title: Oily rag disposal shop schematic
rags-air-and-the-fire-you-do-not-see-com.alt: Shop-safe oily rag disposal: hang dry or metal waste can not plastic bag
rags-air-and-the-fire-you-do-not-see-com.caption: Spread rags to cure or submerge in water in a metal can; never a closed pile.

food-safe-is-a-sentence-not-a-halo.title: Food contact finish claims
food-safe-is-a-sentence-not-a-halo.alt: Compare cured film food contact standards versus marketing food safe labels
food-safe-is-a-sentence-not-a-halo.caption: Regulatory sentences beat front-label halos; cure time and film matter.

fisheye-crater-orange-peel.title: Spray and wipe film defects
fisheye-crater-orange-peel.alt: Diagram fisheye silicone crater and orange peel texture in finish film
fisheye-crater-orange-peel.caption: Fisheye is contamination; orange peel is flow; crater is dirt or solvent pop.

a-staged-dining-table-schedule.title: Dining table finish schedule
a-staged-dining-table-schedule.alt: Multi-day furniture finish schedule stain seal topcoat cure before delivery
a-staged-dining-table-schedule.caption: Table schedule stacks dry time between stain sealer and top build.

what-to-tell-a-client-who-wants-just-oil.title: Oil-only client expectations
what-to-tell-a-client-who-wants-just-oil.alt: Compare maintenance and mark resistance oil finish versus varnish for dining table
what-to-tell-a-client-who-wants-just-oil.caption: Oil looks honest and marks faster; varnish films protect more with less feeding.
